name: MergeTopkAttnOut
reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import json
import os


def run(o_partial, lse_partial):
    lse = lse_partial.float()
    lse_max = lse.max(dim=0, keepdim=True).values
    weights = torch.exp2(lse - lse_max)
    w_sum = weights.sum(dim=0, keepdim=True)
    weights = torch.where(w_sum > 0, weights / w_sum.clamp_min(1e-30), torch.zeros_like(weights))
    out = (o_partial.float() * weights.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=0)
    return out.to(o_partial.dtype)
description: Model that merges split-K partial attention outputs (log2 域 LSE 加权合并)。 对标 vLLM _merge_topk_attn_out_kernel (vllm/models/minimax_m3/common/ops/sparse_attn.py:419, v0.26.0), 即 MiniMax-M3 GQA block-sparse decode kernel (split-K over topk 块) 的合并阶段。
